related.title: Dijkstra：非負最短路徑與失效前提
related.titleEn: Dijkstra: nonnegative shortest paths and assumptions
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付bucket-map.csv與碰撞測試；不得把load0.75推論成查找固定0.75次。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver bucket-map.csv and collision tests; load0.75 does not imply0.75 comparisons per lookup. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 每次列priority queue、settled集合、relax候選與predecessor；保留過期queue項的跳過規則。
related.differenceEn: Trace the priority queue, settled set, relaxation candidates and predecessors, including skipped stale queue entries.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
hash表以hash選bucket但仍需equals分辨碰撞；負載因子不是每bucket長度，也不是所有hash分布都均勻。
本課數值核對：6/8 = 0.75 load_factor；另一項核對：6/16 = 0.375 load_factor。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

Dijkstra在非負權重下逐步確定最短距離；settled的意義依賴該前提，不應偷偷接受負邊。
本課數值核對：2+1+3 = 6 cost；另一項核對：2+8 = 10 cost。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
A hash chooses a bucket but equality resolves collisions; load factor is not each bucket’s length, and hashes need not distribute uniformly.
Numeric audit: 6/8 = 0.75 load_factor; second audit: 6/16 = 0.375 load_factor. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Dijkstra settles shortest distances under nonnegative edge weights; that premise matters and negative edges must not be silently accepted.
Numeric audit: 2+1+3 = 6 cost; second audit: 2+8 = 10 cost. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: ICU CLDR：地區格式與語言回退
related.titleEn: ICU CLDR: locale formatting and language fallback
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付bucket-map.csv與碰撞測試；不得把load0.75推論成查找固定0.75次。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver bucket-map.csv and collision tests; load0.75 does not imply0.75 comparisons per lookup. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 保存原數值與ISO貨幣代碼，再用locale顯示；建立zh-Hant-TW→zh-Hant→default回退的顯式政策。
related.differenceEn: Store numeric values and ISO currency codes, then format by locale; define an explicit zh-Hant-TW→zh-Hant→default fallback policy.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

hash表以hash選bucket但仍需equals分辨碰撞；負載因子不是每bucket長度，也不是所有hash分布都均勻。
本課數值核對：6/8 = 0.75 load_factor；另一項核對：6/16 = 0.375 load_factor。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

locale同時含語言及地區偏好；格式化字串不應再當無地區資訊的數值解析。回退鏈須可見且可由使用者覆寫。
本課數值核對：10.5+20+30.25 = 60.75 currency_units；另一項核對：1234.5*100 = 123450 minor_units。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。

Numeric audit: 6/8 = 0.75 load_factor; second audit: 6/16 = 0.375 load_factor. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

A locale combines language and regional conventions; formatted strings should not be parsed without locale context. Fallback chains should be visible and user-overridable.
Numeric audit: 10.5+20+30.25 = 60.75 currency_units; second audit: 1234.5*100 = 123450 minor_units. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
